summary: Iteration 4 (chat, renewals, birth-date calendar, body charts, PDF report). Backend: 10/10 pytest pass (chat 403 without chat package incl. spoofed chat=true overridden server-side, nutritionist 403, send/receive, unread counts + mark-read, 'after' filter, empty msg 400, birth_date persistence, measurement creation). Frontend (375x667): renewals card + row navigation OK (66 gg -> 05 gen 2027 for annual since 2026-01-05, correct vs system date 2026-11-01); hub-chat-button visible for trainer and client; chat send/receive both directions with no duplicates after 5s polling; birth date picker (year chip 1988 + day 20) updates value, closes, saves (verified in DB); 'Grafici misure' button -> progress screen, chips weight/body_fat/c-vita/bmi switch card values correctly; report-pdf-button no crash, no page errors. BUT on web the PDF button prints the current app screen, not the report (expo-print web ignores html). No deprecated Expo packages detected; no SafeAreaView issues detected.

minor.issue: There is no endpoint to delete a measurement. Wrong or duplicate entries stay forever. Marco Rossi already has 4 duplicate 2026-01-10 entries and 2 duplicate 2026-01-11 entries left by earlier test runs (test_silverpt_api.py never cleans up), and they clutter the charts.
Works, but no frontend code calls it, so neither the hub tile nor the trainer client list shows an unread badge.

ui_bugs.issue: src/report.ts:73-75 calls Print.printAsync({html}) on web. expo-print's web version (node_modules/expo-print/build/ExponentPrint.web.js) just calls window.print() and ignores the html, so the browser prints the current app screen instead of the report. No crash. Fix: on web, open a new window or a hidden iframe, write the html into it, then call print() on that window.

integration_issues.issue: Nothing in the frontend calls /api/chat-unread, so users never see a new-message indicator on hub-chat-button or in the trainer client list.

issues: The y-axis always starts at 0, so small changes (85->84 cm waist, 80->79 kg) look like a flat line. Scale the axis to the data's min/max with some padding.
BMI axis labels show 3 decimals (27.170, 20.377). Round them.
The line ends at about 75% of the chart width, leaving empty space on the right.
X labels are MM-DD only, so data spanning several years is ambiguous.
The 'Completa le prime sessioni...' empty message appears even when measurement charts exist below it.
The renewal date shows no year ('05 gen'). Consider adding it for annual plans.
The trainer's chat header says 'Chat coaching' and does not name the client.
If one poll fails, setMsgs([]) clears the conversation and the input bar is hidden until the next successful poll.
profile-save-message uses the success color even for error messages.

action_items: Fix the web PDF report: in src/report.ts, on web, write the html into a new window or iframe and print that, instead of Print.printAsync, which only prints the current page.
Add DELETE /api/measurements/{id} plus a UI action, and clean up the duplicate 2026-01-10 and 2026-01-11 measurements on Marco Rossi.
Call /api/chat-unread to show unread badges on hub-chat-button and the trainer client list.
Body charts: scale the y-axis to min/max instead of 0, round axis labels, and fill the full chart width.
critical_code_review_comments: Chat access checks are correct: assert_access (without allow_nutri) blocks nutritionists, and the subscription chat flag is recomputed server-side from package features, so clients cannot spoof it.
chat GET marks the other party's messages read on every 5s poll. This is fine, but the GET mutates state.
nextRenewal assumes 'since' is YYYY-MM-DD. A full ISO string would give Invalid Date and show 'NaN gg' (no infinite loop).

success_rate.frontend: 92% (PDF on web prints the wrong content)

seed_data_creation: No seed data left behind. TEST_ chat messages and measurements were deleted. Marco's subscription (annual, chat=true, since 2026-01-05) and birth_date 1990-05-10 were restored.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run backend tests with EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL exported (frontend/.env) plus MONGO_URL/DB_NAME for cleanup. System date is 2026-11-01. Marco Rossi client id 6ae7273ec8f277d3e820ac37 has 11 measurements, including duplicates from older runs.
rca_of_issue: PDF on web: expo-print's web module print() = window.print() and never uses options.html, so it prints the SPA page.
